parameters.name: DataFormat
parameters.description:
The Swagger text format:

*   json
*   yaml

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to overwrite the existing API.

APIs with the same HTTP request type and backend request path are considered the same.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi dry-run-swagger --overwrite true --data-format yaml --data A_Swagger_API_definition_in_YAML --group-id d633cf5524f841b9950e245b191bdabf --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DryRunSwagger --region cn-hangzhou --Overwrite true --GlobalCondition '{}' --DataFormat yaml --Data A_Swagger_API_definition_in_YAML --GroupId d633cf5524f841b9950e245b191bdabf
